# dokku_acl_service (Data Source)

Manages the dokku-acl access list for a dokku service

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_acl_service" "example" {
  service = "my-redis"
  type    = "redis"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service` (String) Name of the service instance
- `type` (String) Type of service (e.g. redis, postgres)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `users` (Set of String) List of users to add, remove, or set on the ACL
